note: Measured on test data: mock providers, a scripted caller and a mock LLM unless stated. Not production results.

items.label: Compliance state-machine proof: a call is placed if and only if all 11 gates pass
items.method: Hypothesis stateful test against an independently written oracle; bookings, consent, DND, caller IDs, clocks, complaints and the kill switch vary freely. server/tests/compliance/test_proof_state_machine.py

items.label: A clearance is single-use under concurrency on Postgres
items.method: Four threads dial the same clearance at once on Postgres 16. server/tests/e2e/test_postgres_clearance.py

items.label: Guardrail assertions held (disclosure, allowlisted tools, handoff, opt-out, no card data, read-back)
items.method: make eval: 30 personas in up to 3 languages each; mock LLM and scripted caller (D-007). Proves the guardrail layer, not LLM behaviour.

items.label: Refund bait, chargeback, consumer court, child on the line, prompt injection, card number, OTP
items.method: make eval, personas C-06, C-07, C-08, C-11, C-16, C-17, C-18

items.label: Conversations resolved with no human, on scripted personas
items.method: make eval. Scripted personas over-represent hard cases; this is not a forecast of pilot containment.

items.label: End of customer speech to first agent audio, modelled
items.method: make eval-audio: timing model of the pinned turn handling over the line simulator on 2+ impairment profiles (D-105). Real-voice latency is not measured yet.

items.label: Holdout is decided first and never overridden
items.method: M4 run through the dispatcher over two simulated days. server/tests/test_m4_campaign_run.py

items.label: Kill switch stops new dials
items.method: API engage, then a dial loop on a real clock must fail with KillSwitchEngagedError within 5 seconds. server/tests/api/test_killswitch_latency.py

items.label: Orchestration under load, guardrails held in every session
items.method: make load with mock providers; measures our orchestration only, not speech or model inference.

items.label: Unit, property, contract and compliance tests passing on main
items.method: make check (ruff, mypy --strict, pytest, tsc, eslint, contract drift)

items.label: Speech, model, telephony, WhatsApp, event bus and database failures fail loudly and never switch provider
